text: せっかく　ハナダのみさきに　くる　なら…　ふたりじゃ　なくちゃ

structure.jp: せっかく　ハナダのみさきに　くる　なら…
structure.en: if you're coming all the way to Cerulean Cape

structure.jp: ふたりじゃ　なくちゃ
structure.en: it has to be as two

patterns.name: 〜なければならない
patterns.span: ふたりじゃ　なくちゃ
patterns.explanation: なくちゃ is a casual short form of 'if it is not…, it won't do', meaning 'it must be'. ふたりじゃ　なくちゃ = 'it has to be two people'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a verb means 'if that is what you are going to do'. くる　なら = 'if you're going to come'.
